note: Canonical-selection validation over the five primary structures. 'expected' lists canonically defensible target(s); 'closure' means null (developmental sufficiency / no current target).

cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: This paragraph is about school uniforms. School uniforms are matching clothes that all students wear. Many schools around the world use them, and they come in different colors and styles.

cases.scenario: several independent points lacking an integrated message
cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Uniforms reduce bullying. They also save parents money. Some countries require them by law. They can look pretty nice too, and they make mornings faster.

cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Our school should require uniforms because they reduce the social pressure students feel about clothing. This single change would meaningfully improve the school day.

cases.scenario: evidence present without elaboration (Evidence must NOT outrank Elaboration)
cases.assignment: Write one paragraph persuading readers that your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Uniforms reduce distraction. A 2019 survey found 62% of teachers reported fewer clothing-related disruptions after a uniform policy, and one nearby school cut dress-code referrals in half the year they adopted uniforms.

cases.scenario: evidence genuinely needed (elaborated mechanism, no concrete instance)
cases.assignment: Write one paragraph persuading readers that your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Our school should require uniforms because they reduce social pressure. When everyone dresses similarly, students spend less mental energy comparing themselves to others and more on their work; the constant low-level anxiety of being judged for what you wear fades, which frees attention for learning and lowers the daily stress of getting dressed.

cases.scenario: evidence NOT needed (reflective purpose, self-sufficient meaning)
cases.assignment: Write one reflective paragraph about a small thing that changes how your school day feels.
cases.text: When I wear the same outfit as everyone else, I stop wondering whether I look right and start paying attention to the lesson. That small shift, from watching myself to being present, is what makes uniforms matter to me: they quiet a noise I did not realize I was carrying.

cases.scenario: abrupt opening where orientation is needed (whole-piece unit)
cases.assignment: Write a short persuasive essay on whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Ban them. That is my view. They cause more problems than they solve, and honestly most students agree with me on this.

cases.scenario: no opening where none is needed (paragraph opens directly with thesis)
cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Our school should require uniforms because they reduce the social pressures that pull students' attention away from learning.

cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Uniforms matter a lot. In conclusion, that is exactly why our school should adopt them as soon as possible.

cases.scenario: conclusion that merely repeats the thesis (developed paragraph)
cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Our school should require uniforms because they reduce social pressure. When everyone dresses alike, students compare themselves less and focus more; my cousin's school saw the constant judging about brands fade within a month of switching, and classmates seemed calmer. Therefore, our school should require uniforms because they reduce social pressure.

cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: Our school should require uniforms because they reduce social pressure and because they save families money on clothing.

cases.scenario: strong paragraph requiring closure, not invented weakness
cases.assignment: Write one paragraph arguing whether your school should require uniforms.
cases.text: While many worry that uniforms erase individuality, our school should require them because they lower the daily social pressure that distracts students from learning. When clothing stops being a status signal, students spend less energy comparing themselves and more on their work; a nearby school that adopted uniforms reported that dress-related conflicts nearly disappeared within a term. That change matters because it shows uniforms do not suppress identity so much as remove a distraction from it, letting students bring their attention to what they came to school to do.
